title: Information-Geometric Blind Spots of Conformal Test Martingales
abstract: arXiv:2610.23131v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conformal test martingales (CTMs) are e-processes for sequentially testing exchangeability via p-values produced by a conformity function $A$. However, any distribution shift that preserves the push-forward $P\circ A^{-1}$ leaves the p-value distribution invariant, rendering it invisible to every CTM based on $A$. We formalise this blind spot through the \emph{$A$-equivalence class} $[P]_A$ and show that, for any target distribution $T$, there is a unique closest element $Q^\ast\in[P]_A$ in KL divergence---the \emph{$A$-cryptic I-projection}---with explicit density $q^\ast(z) = t(z)\,p_S(A(z))/t_S(A(z))$ and a Pythagorean decomposition into detectable and cryptic components. When $A$ is the Neyman-Pearson likelihood ratio, the cryptic component vanishes, connecting our result to optimal e-value design. We demonstrate the theory on high-dimensional image data by empirically constructing this I-projection. By conditionally resampling EMN

translated_title: 共形检验鞅的信息几何盲区
translated_abstract: 共形检验鞅（CTM）是通过由符合性函数 A 生成的 p 值来序贯检验可交换性的 e-过程。然而，任何保持前推分布 P∘A⁻¹ 不变的分布偏移都会使 p 值的分布保持不变，从而对所有基于 A 的共形检验鞅而言都是不可察觉的。我们通过 A-等价类 [P]_A 对这一盲区进行形式化，并证明对于任意目标分布 T，在 KL 散度意义下 [P]_A 中存在唯一的最近元素 Q*——即 A-隐秘 I-投影，其具有显式密度 q*(z) = t(z) p_S(A(z))/t_S(A(z))，并可分解为可检测分量与隐秘分量的勾股分解。当 A 取为 Neyman-Pearson 似然比时，隐秘分量消失，由此将我们的结果与最优 e 值设计联系起来。我们通过在高维图像数据上经验性地构造该 I-投影来展示这一理论，通过条件重采样 EMNIST……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了共形检验鞅的信息几何盲区：凡保持符合性函数前推分布不变的分布偏移均无法被检测，并借助 A-等价类与 A-隐秘 I-投影给出该盲区的显式刻画与勾股分解，同时证明当符合性函数取 Neyman-Pearson 似然比时盲区消失。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes the information-geometric blind spots of conformal test martingales via A-equivalence classes—showing that distribution shifts preserving the conformity function's pushforward are undetectable—and characterizes the closest such shift as the A-cryptic I-projection, which vanishes when the Neyman-Pearson likelihood ratio is used as the conformity function.
